topic: Someone receives a package intended for the previous tenant
text: I glance around the room, the air seeming denser than usual, as I hold the package in my hands. It's not mine, that much is clear, but the address tape reads my new address, stark and unyielding. I can feel the weight of it, more than just the physical heft, a burden of sorts. The name of the previous tenant stares back at me, a stranger now, and I wonder how many more of these parcels will find their way to my door. I should contact the sender, shouldn't I? But what if this is just the beginning, a constant stream of reminders of the life that once was here? The thought settles in my chest, heavy and unwelcome.
